title: Order Notifications
desc: Send automated WhatsApp messages to customers at key moments in their order journey
resetConfirm: Reset all templates to default messages? Your custom messages will be lost.

typeDesc.abandoned_cart: Remind customers who left items in their cart
typeDesc.order_confirmed: Notify customers when their order is placed
typeDesc.order_shipped: Alert customers when their order ships
typeDesc.review_request: Ask customers to leave a review after delivery
typeDesc.digital_delivery: Send download instructions for digital products

connectWhatsAppHint: Link a WhatsApp number to this store to start sending.
whatsappTemplateNote: Delivered as a Meta-approved WhatsApp template whose wording is fixed at approval time. Editing the text above does NOT change what your customer receives — it is kept only as this notification's record.
noDeliveryRail: Not available yet — this type has no approved WhatsApp template.
whatsappUnavailableZid: WhatsApp cannot be connected for stores linked through Zid at the moment, so these notifications cannot be sent yet.
